condition.note: stated as an antecedent to reason from. Dula does not forecast construction demand and makes no claim that this happens.
condition.means: the analysis below is CONDITIONAL ON THIS. It does not claim it happens.

reads: a conditional mechanism analysis: what could travel, by what route, under what conditions, and what would decide how large it is

pathways.mechanism: construction buys fabricated metal products as an intermediate input; more building means more of that input bought somewhere
pathways.direction_means: the change would push in the same direction
pathways.status_means: the mechanism plus the conditions under which it would operate. Still no magnitude.
operates_if: the county's 17 fabricated metal products establishments (NAICS 332) make products matching construction specifications
they hold capacity headroom, or can add it
buyers source within the county rather than outside it
what_would_determine_magnitude: what share of construction's input spend is currently sourced in-county — NOT OBSERVED; nothing held records a purchase
capacity headroom at those 17 establishments (83 employees) — unknown
product match inside NAICS 332, which is a broad commodity class
published detail is a floor: suppressed cells mean the local base is known only to a lower bound
counter_effects: if no local producer matches the specification, the additional demand leaves the county entirely and the local effect is zero
a larger county supplier outside Santa Fe may absorb it on price
pathways.note: Fabricated metal products is 16.3% of the national intermediate basket
pathways.magnitude: NOT ESTIMATED — Dula holds no response coefficient for this

pathways.mechanism: more construction output requires more construction labour; a tighter labour market bids wages up
pathways.direction_means: the sign depends on which of two opposing mechanisms dominates
pathways.status_means: the mechanism plus the conditions under which it would operate. Still no magnitude.
operates_if: the labour shed is not already fully employed
what_would_determine_magnitude: slack in the construction workforce across the labour shed — not observed

who the earnings accrue to: self-containment is 63% AT MOST, so a share of any wage gain accrues to workers who RESIDE in other counties. LODES establishes residence and workplace, nothing more — where those earnings are then spent is not observed, and no spending leakage is claimed here
547 establishments averaging 5.4 employees — small firms may be capacity-constrained before they are labour-constrained
counter_effects: higher wages raise construction costs, which works against the demand that started the chain

a share of the wage gain accrues to workers residing in other counties, while the cost effect falls on builders operating here. Whether that changes local spending is a further question the commuting record cannot answer
pathways.note: the standard ambiguity: good for workers, a cost to builders
pathways.magnitude: NOT ESTIMATED — Dula holds no response coefficient for this

constraints.statement: Whether the county's 17 fabricated metal establishments (83 employees) can take on more work — equipment, premises, skilled staff. Nothing held measures utilisation.
constraints.means: a development archetype addresses a constraint; it does not become a candidate because the constraint exists

constraints.statement: Whether skilled construction labour is available across the shed, and whether training reaches where those workers actually live.
constraints.means: a development archetype addresses a constraint; it does not become a candidate because the constraint exists

constraints.statement: Whether builders would buy locally at all. This is the hinge: every supplier pathway above passes through it.
constraints.means: a development archetype addresses a constraint; it does not become a candidate because the constraint exists

value_at_stake.kind_means: value to the place -- wages paid, output produced, jobs retained. It accrues to residents and the local economy, and no one owns it.
value_at_stake.note: value AT STAKE under a conditional pathway; not created, not captured
value_at_stake.statement: Wages and output at local fabricators, if any of the additional input demand is sourced in-county. This accrues to the place.
value_at_stake.creation_vs_capture: this is potential CREATION. Whether anyone captures it is a separate claim, and it needs an observed capture event before it can be made.

value_at_stake.kind_means: value of the firm or the asset itself. It belongs to whoever owns it, and it exists whether or not anyone is buying.
value_at_stake.note: value AT STAKE under a conditional pathway; not created, not captured
value_at_stake.statement: Higher utilisation would raise what those firms are worth to their owners. That is a different quantity from the wages above, and the two may not be added.
value_at_stake.creation_vs_capture: this is potential CREATION. Whether anyone captures it is a separate claim, and it needs an observed capture event before it can be made.

note: No investment value is stated. Investment value exists only relative to an entry price, and no asset here carries one, so the model refuses to put a figure on it.
magnitude_note: No pathway carries a number. Dula holds no response coefficient for any of these routes, and the model refuses to carry one. What each pathway states instead is what would determine its size.
effect_note: These are MECHANISMS, not effects. Claiming an effect occurred needs an observed actor response and an identification strategy; describing the route needs neither.
